summary: The single declaration of the work-to-work relation vocabulary. Every projection of these terms is derived from this file: the stored-kind set the relations CHECK constraint admits, the fold's accepted kinds and its per-kind link refusals, the query labels the relation read surface serves, which labels permit transitive closure, and the event population that assigns relation identity.

kinds.summary: The source work must reach a terminal state before the target work can start.
kinds.transitive_meaning: Closure reports transitive delay: the source delays the target through a chain. It does not claim that clearing the source alone unblocks the target.

kinds.summary: Two overlapping work items were judged able to proceed together.

link_refusal.message: overlap-resolution relations must be created by resolve_overlap
link_refusal.recovery: use resolve_overlap so operator approval, version pins, and lifecycle changes remain atomic

kinds.summary: The source work requires the target work. Distinct from blocks: a dependency is a stated requirement, not a scheduling bar.
kinds.transitive_meaning: Closure reports the transitive requirement set reachable from the source.

kinds.summary: Workflow composition linked a successor work item. Written only by the workflow dispatcher; no operator surface creates it.
The source work carries out the target work's stated intent.
Ordered Initiative membership. The edge mirrors an initiative_entries row.

link_refusal.message: Initiative membership edges must be created by Initiative entry events

kinds.summary: The source work was merged into the target work and terminalized.

link_refusal.message: overlap-resolution relations must be created by resolve_overlap
link_refusal.recovery: use resolve_overlap so operator approval, version pins, and lifecycle changes remain atomic

kinds.summary: Structural containment between two ordinary work items.
The source work was raised out of the target work as a distinct concern.
The source work replaces the target work. One successor per target.
kinds.transitive_meaning: Closure reports the successor chain to the surviving work item.

link_refusal.message: supersedes relations must be created by work.superseded
link_refusal.recovery: append a work.superseded event so the edge and lifecycle change remain atomic
